documents.text: Leeds Boar Lane. Cust [CUSTOMER] [CUSTOMER] came in approx 12.30, upset. Wanted to dispute £35 overdraft charges on Oct statement. Says she would not have gone into unarranged o/d if she could have moved money on Fri 30/10 but couldnt log in to app all day. Also says when she came in Sat 31/10 to ask about it, colleague [STAFF_2] told her 'the app was fine, you must have forgotten your password' and 'there's nothing I can do, it's in the T&Cs', in front of other customers, and walked off while she was talking. She found this humiliating. I apologised, explained I cant refund fees in branch, told her it will be logged as a complaint and complaints team will call her back. She gave mobile [CUSTOMER_PHONE]. - [STAFF_1]

Subject: Complaint from yesterday at Boar Lane

Hi,

I was in the Boar Lane branch yesterday and the man there ([STAFF_1]) was really kind and said I'd get a call. I want to put it in writing as well so nothing gets missed.

1. I was charged £35 in overdraft fees for October. I only went overdrawn because I couldn't get into my app on Friday 30th to move my money across from my savings. I want that refunded.
2. The staff member I spoke to on Saturday, [STAFF_2], was rude and dismissive. He told me I'd forgotten my password in front of a queue of people, which was embarrassing, and then just walked away. I want an apology and for someone to speak to him.
3. Your app was down for most of Friday, which was payday for a lot of people. Nobody told me anything, there was no message in the app or a text. I want to know what happened and that it won't happen again.

Thanks,
[CUSTOMER]
Account [ACCOUNT_1]

INCIDENT INC-2026-1030-01 (P1) Service: H&V mobile app + online banking. Impact: app and online banking unavailable 30/10/2026 07:10-15:40. Cause: failed certificate rotation on authentication gateway following overnight change CHG-88213. Card payments and ATMs unaffected, 3DS in-app approvals unavailable for duration. Telephone banking queues peaked 74 min. Status: RESOLVED 15:40. Customer impact review: open, owner Digital Ops.

CA [ACCOUNT_1]. Arranged o/d limit GBP 250. 30/10/2026 balance moved to GBP -412.55 (unarranged GBP 162.55) after card spend + SO. 31/10/2026 Transfer SAV>CA GBP 600.00 (branch counter). 02/11/2026 Overdraft charges Oct GBP 35.00 debited (arranged interest GBP 6.20, unarranged usage fee GBP 28.80). No fee refunds in last 12m.
